descriptions.preferred: 马洛由荷兰的 Van der Maat 苗圃选育命名并推广，春天 新叶为玫红色和绿色的斑叶，在花吹雪、泰勒、秋筱锦 等斑叶中，马洛的色彩会更加浓郁具有冲击力，而且它 玫红色的色彩可以一直持续到 6 月底 7 月初，夏季粉红 色变为奶白色，二次新稍出锦率更高，常有全红色叶， 秋季为鲜红色，生长速度较慢，灌木状生长特性，矮生性， 午后需要遮阴，夏季建议强遮阴，成年株可达 1. 5 米左 右高度。

sources.name: Marlo Variegated Pink Japanese Maple
sources.description: Marlo is a new variegated japanese maple. it has bold pink new growth, and has lime green and whites mixed in. A very unique and rare japanese maple. slow growing, similar to Butterfly, but will more pinks.

rhs.description: A bushy, upright, deciduous shrub with five- to seven-lobed palmate leaves. These are deep green, greyish towards the centre, with a broad, irregular, cream to pink margin turning deep pink in spring and autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Low Maintenance, Patio/Container Plants, Flower borders and beds
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dissectum group have fine, feathery, deeply divided leaves with finely serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in moist, humus-rich, well-drained, acid to neutral soil. Hot dry air, cold wind and late frost may cause leaf scorching. Mulch in autumn to protect shallow roots from cold and drying out
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润、富含腐殖质、排水良好的酸性至中性土壤中。炎热干燥的空气、寒风及晚霜都可能导致叶缘焦枯。秋季覆 mulch，可保护浅根系免受寒冷与失水伤害。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 落叶灌木，株形浓密直立，具五至七裂掌状叶。 叶片深绿色，近叶中央略带灰绿色，边缘宽大且不规则，呈乳白至粉色，春秋两季会转为深粉色。

attributes.suggested_uses: 适合城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、低维护花园、庭院/容器栽培，以及花境和花坛。
attributes.hort_group_description: dissectum 组的槭树具有细致、羽毛状、深裂的叶片，叶缘具细锯齿。
